name: Manual-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies an operator action applied to the associated mechanism.
description: This qualifier identifies an operator action applied to the associated mechanism. A manual mechanism can operate a switch, valve, latch or adjustment without having its own electrical supply. The qualifier tells the reader how an action originates, while the main symbol still identifies what the device does.
For a local operating station, connect the operation mark to the relevant device tag and contact references. This avoids reading the operator itself as another electrical load.
readingNotes: Keep the qualifier linked to the device it operates rather than treating it as another electrical terminal.
Manual operation is a mechanism attribute, not a normally-open or normally-closed contact state.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Keep the qualifier linked to the device it operates rather than treating it as another electrical terminal.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Manual operation is a mechanism attribute, not a normally-open or normally-closed contact state.
